tasks.label: Framework: Install VS Code Skills
tasks.detail: Installs VS Code skills provided by the custom devcontainer framework when available.
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if [ -f /opt/devcontainer/skills/install.sh ] && [ -f /opt/devcontainer/skills/index.js ]; then bash /opt/devcontainer/skills/install.sh && node /opt/devcontainer/skills/index.js; else echo "[Framework] VS Code Skills installer is not available in this devcontainer. Task skipped."; fi'
